answer: The farm's onyx arrived yesterday, its quartz arrived this morning, and its echo never arrived at all. An honest agent spends 28 minutes once; the farm spends 12404 minutes and still owns nothing it can sell. The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Loom master loom shuttle seal woven at the finishing shop: the toll is each loom shuttle is a measured cloth yield plus a guild signature, paid in the open. The farm's story ends the same way every epoch: a hundred keys printed, and no proof among them.
